_comment: This file is a pytest test module with no callable APIs or CLI entry points. It contains only test functions (test_validate_language_models_and_tokenize_laser3, test_validate_language_models_and_tokenize_laser2, test_validate_language_models_and_tokenize_mock_laser3, test_validate_language_models_and_tokenize_mock_laser2) and a MockLaserModelDownloader class used exclusively for testing. Per the rules, files without callable code usable via a simple argparse CLI module are excluded.
